Action 9 attempts to type text into a file input element, which violates action compatibility rules. File inputs require file selection/upload actions, not text entry.
The input value 'No file chosen' is default UI placeholder text, not a valid file path or semantically correct data.
The test case is incomplete: it lacks a valid file selection step and does not trigger the final 'Upload' button on the Upload page, leaving the flow unfinished.
Action 9 uses a 'Type' action on a file input element. File inputs require a file selection or upload action, not text input.
The input value 'No file chosen' is semantically incorrect as it copies the default UI placeholder text instead of providing a valid file path or selection.
The test case omits the mandatory intermediate step of actually selecting a file on the Upload page before triggering the submission button.

Step 9 attempts to type text into a file input field ('Select a file to upload to your account.'), which violates action compatibility rules. File inputs require a file selection or upload action, not text entry.

Missing required intermediate action: The test case does not include a valid file selection or upload step before triggering the 'Upload' button, violating the flow coherence rule that a file must be selected before upload.
Typing 'No file chosen' (default placeholder text) into a file field is semantically incorrect and technically impossible in standard web automation.
